description.zh: 六章拆开 VLA 的输入、动作接口、训练和执行。把模型结构放回机器人闭环，用原论文图、具体信号和可操作实验理解每个环节。
description.en: Six chapters connect VLA inputs, action interfaces, training and execution. Read model architectures inside the robot control loop, with original figures, concrete signals and interactive experiments.

title.zh: VLA 01｜从看见到真正行动

summary.zh: 沿着被挪动的杯子，讲清 VLA 的输入、动作接口、反馈闭环与证据边界。
summary.en: Reconstruct a VLA control loop through a cup that moves after observation.

title.zh: 第一帧之后，杯子被挪走了
title.en: The cup moves after the first image

text.zh: 请机器人把红杯子放进左边的托盘。它看见场景，开始伸手，这时有人挪动了杯子。原来的动作轨迹，现在指向空处，而不是杯子。真正值得追问的是：什么信息能够改变下一条指令？这套课程将跟随这条指令，从相机像素走到真实的物理结果。我们会区分理解任务、生成动作，以及执行期间纠正动作这三件事。
text.en: Ask a robot to place the red cup in the left tray. It sees the scene, begins reaching, and somebody moves the cup. A remembered trajectory now points toward empty space instead of the object. The interesting question is what information can change the next command. This course follows that command from camera pixels to physical consequences. We separate understanding the request, generating motion, and correcting it during execution.

title.zh: 给 VLA 一个可操作的定义

text.zh: VLA 是视觉、语言和动作：机器人策略中相互连接的三部分。视觉观测告诉策略，机器人周围目前能够看见什么。语言指定目标任务，例如选择红杯子，而不是蓝杯子。输出最终必须落到机器人能够执行的控制接口中。仅仅描述照片的模型，还没有完成这种映射。不同论文会用不同的结构和动作表示，来建立这种连接。
text.en: VLA stands for vision, language, and action: three connected parts of a robot policy. Visual observations tell the policy what is currently visible around the robot. Language specifies the intended task, such as choosing the red cup rather than the blue one. The output must eventually specify actions in a robot's executable control interface. A model that only describes the photograph has not completed this mapping. Different papers implement this connection with different architectures and action representations.

title.zh: 策略是一个条件分布
title.en: The policy is a conditional distribution

text.zh: 把策略写成一个分布：根据观测和指令，给出可能的动作。观测可以包含多路图像、近期历史，以及机器人的实测关节状态。动作可以是一条指令，也可以是一小段连续指令。条件化意味着：同一个场景，换一句指令，就应该产生不同的行为。使用分布，也允许机器人以几种不同但合理的方式绕过障碍。不过，这并不自动保证每个采样动作都安全，也不保证任务成功。
text.en: Write the policy as a distribution over actions, conditioned on observations and the instruction. The observation may contain several images, recent history, and the robot's measured joint state. The action may be one command or an entire short sequence of commands. Conditioning means the same scene can produce different behavior when the instruction changes. A distribution also allows several sensible ways of reaching around an obstacle. It does not automatically certify that every sampled movement will be safe or successful.

title.zh: 图像、状态和历史分别解决什么
title.en: Images, state, and history have different jobs

text.zh: 外部相机显示杯子与托盘，腕部相机显示抓取区域。即使机械臂部分被遮挡，关节编码器仍能报告机器人的构型。这些测量互相补充，并不是完全等价的信息副本。单幅图像不能揭示所有相关速度、接触力和被遮挡表面。历史可以帮助推断运动，但也会增加计算量，而且必须保证时间对齐。因此，仅用摄像头观察人类，并不意味着机器人应丢掉自己的传感器。
text.en: The outside camera shows the cup and tray, while a wrist camera shows the grasp region. Joint encoders report the robot's configuration, even when an arm is partly hidden. These measurements complement each other; they do not contain exactly the same information. A single image cannot reveal every relevant velocity, contact force, or occluded surface. History can help infer motion, but it also increases computation and must remain temporally aligned. Camera-only human observation does not mean discarding the robot's own sensors.

title.zh: 像素变成特征，不等于完整世界
title.en: Pixels become features, not a ready-made world

text.zh: 在 OpenVLA 中，图像编码器产生视觉特征，再投影到语言模型的输入空间。指令 token 和图像特征共同影响机器人动作 token 的预测。原论文结构图把这个接口画得很清楚：图像进入，数值动作输出。这些内部特征，不一定是显式点云、网格，或者经过标定的物体地图。即使没有输出完整几何重建，有用的表示仍然可以支持控制。但这种表示在遮挡下是否依然可靠，需要用实验回答。
text.en: In OpenVLA, image encoders produce visual features that are projected into the language model. Instruction tokens and image features then influence predictions of robot action tokens. The architecture figure shows this interface: images enter, numerical actions leave. Those internal features need not be an explicit point cloud, mesh, or calibrated object map. A useful representation can support control without exposing a complete geometric reconstruction. Whether that representation remains reliable under occlusion is an experimental question.

title.zh: 动作向量是一份接口约定
title.en: An action vector is an interface contract

text.zh: 假设教学机器人接收三维平移变化、三维旋转变化，以及一个夹爪数值。单看这七个数字，我们还不知道指令到底是什么意思。平移可以使用米或毫米，坐标系可以跟随机器人手腕，也可以固定在基座。旋转可能采用特定的轴约定；夹爪值可能表示位置，也可能表示打开指令。把模型输出转换为执行指令时，适配层必须保留这些含义。张量形状兼容，只是接口检查的第一步。
text.en: Suppose a robot receives three translation changes, three rotation changes, and a gripper value. Seven numbers alone do not tell us what those commands actually mean. Translation could use meters or millimeters, in a frame following the wrist or fixed to the base. Rotation uses an axis convention; gripper values might mean position or an open command. An adapter must preserve all these meanings when converting the model output for execution. Shape compatibility is only the first interface check.

title.zh: 一个很小的单位错误，改变整段动作
title.en: One small unit error changes the motion

text.zh: 下面是数值教学例子，不是某篇论文的机器人实验结果。策略要求在基座坐标系中，水平移动两厘米。这个位移就是零点零二米，也就是二十毫米。如果适配层把以米表示的数值当成毫米，执行位移就会非常小。如果参考坐标系发生旋转，即使比例正确，运动方向也可能错误。这些失败看起来像模型不够聪明，实际却可能来自确定性的转换错误。
text.en: Here is a numerical teaching example, not a published robot benchmark. The policy requests a horizontal change of two centimeters in the base frame. That displacement is zero point zero two meters, or twenty millimeters. If an adapter interprets the meter value as millimeters, the commanded motion becomes negligible. If the reference frame is rotated, even a correctly scaled value can point the wrong way. These failures can resemble poor intelligence while originating in a deterministic conversion.

title.zh: 策略不是电机伺服环
title.en: The policy is not the motor servo

text.zh: 动作解码以后，控制器仍然要驱动真实关节，追踪给定参考。这个控制器可能处理插值、逆运动学、关节限位，以及硬件反馈。具体分工取决于策略输出的是关节目标、末端运动，还是力矩。所以，策略更新与底层伺服更新，不必发生在同一个频率。把模型称为端到端，并不会让物理执行器和周围所有接口消失。判断实际表现时，应当评估完整部署系统。
text.en: After action decoding, a controller still has to move real joints toward the requested reference. It may handle interpolation, inverse kinematics, joint limits, and hardware feedback. The division depends on whether the policy outputs joint targets, end-effector motion, or torque. A policy update and a low-level servo update therefore need not happen at the same frequency. Calling a model end-to-end does not remove physical actuators or every interface around it. Evaluate the complete deployed system when judging practical behavior.

title.zh: 预测一整段，不代表全部执行
title.en: Predicting a chunk does not mean executing all of it

text.zh: 许多策略会根据一次观测，预测包含若干未来指令的动作块。预测时域表示提出多少条指令；执行时域表示实际执行其中多少条。举个例子：预测十步，只执行两步，然后重新观察场景。剩余八步预测，可以根据杯子移动后的新证据进行替换。这就是滚动时域执行，它将连贯的短动作与反馈连接起来。这里的数字只是教学设定，并不是所有 VLA 的默认配置。
text.en: Many policies predict a chunk containing several future commands from one observation. The prediction horizon counts proposed commands; the execution horizon counts those applied. For illustration, predict ten steps, execute only two, then observe the scene again. The remaining eight predictions can be replaced using newer evidence about the moved cup. This is receding-horizon execution, and it helps connect coherent short motions with feedback. The numbers here define our example, not the default configuration of every VLA.

title.zh: 闭环意味着新证据改变动作
title.en: Closed loop means new evidence changes action

text.zh: 回到第一帧之后被挪动的杯子。闭环策略可以观察新位置，并调整后续指令。不过，机器人无法改写已经在物理世界中执行的指令。相机延迟、模型推理，以及排队动作，都会推迟纠正真正生效的时刻。因此，相机频繁采集，并不保证行为也能以同样频率得到纠正。后面的章节会画出完整时间图，而不是把帧率直接当成反应速度。
text.en: Return to the cup that moved after the first observation. A closed-loop policy can observe the new location and adjust a later command. But the robot cannot revise commands that have already been executed in the physical world. Camera delay, model inference, and queued actions all postpone when correction takes effect. Consequently, a camera running frequently does not guarantee equally frequent behavioral correction. Later we will draw the full timing diagram instead of treating frame rate as responsiveness.

title.zh: 读下一篇论文时先问这些

text.zh: 判断一个新 VLA 之前，先重建它从输入到执行的完整路径。确认哪些观测和指令进入策略，以及输出采用什么动作接口。接着定位训练监督、反馈时序，以及评估条件。对于被挪动的杯子，要问新图像最早何时能够影响物理指令。这个问题把语义理解与真实行为连接起来，同时不预设任何一方单独就够用。下一章，我们直接拆解动作表示：数值、token、轨迹，以及生成式解码器。

This links semantic understanding to robot behavior without assuming either alone is sufficient. Next, we inspect action representations: numbers, tokens, trajectories, and generative decoders.

title.zh: 先有动作空间，再选解码方式
title.en: The action space comes before the decoder

text.zh: 机器人现在知道要抓哪个杯子，但下一步动作仍然需要一种表示。三个不同决定经常被混在一起：动作含义、时间分组，以及预测方法。动作含义规定关节目标或笛卡尔变化，以及单位和坐标约定。时间分组规定模型预测一条指令，还是一起预测多条指令。预测方法则选择 token、回归、扩散，或者连续动作上的学习流。改变其中一个决定，并不意味着必须同时改变另外两个。
text.en: Our robot now knows which cup to grasp, but its next movement still needs a representation. Three different decisions are often mixed together: action meaning, temporal grouping, and prediction method. Meaning specifies joint targets or Cartesian changes, with units and coordinate conventions. Grouping specifies whether the model predicts one command or several commands together. Prediction specifies tokens, regression, diffusion, or a learned flow over continuous actions. Changing one decision does not logically require changing the other two.

title.zh: 连续动作与离散编码

text.zh: 物理位移是连续量，即使模型用离散 token 来表示它。分词器把位移分配给一个编码，解码器再把编码还原成数值。因此，预测 token 不代表机器人只能停在少数几个物理位置。控制器执行解码后的参考，还可能在时间上对这些参考进行插值。但量化确实会引入近似误差，其影响取决于任务容差。接近杯子时够用的粗糙动作表示，在紧配合插入附近可能就不够了。
text.en: A physical displacement is continuous even when a model represents it with a discrete token. A tokenizer assigns that displacement to a code, and a decoder maps the code back to a number. Therefore, token prediction does not imply that the robot can occupy only a few physical positions. The controller executes decoded references and may interpolate between them over time. Quantization does introduce approximation error, and its consequences depend on the task's tolerance. A coarse movement representation may suffice for approaching a cup but struggle near a tight insertion.

title.zh: 八个分箱的数值例子

text.zh: 考虑一个教学平移范围：从负四厘米到正四厘米。把这个范围分成八个等宽分箱，每个分箱解码成中心值。每个分箱宽一厘米，因此范围内最大误差是半厘米。要求移动一点二厘米，会变成一点五厘米，误差为三毫米。增加分箱数量能够降低这个误差上界，但也会改变预测难度和序列设计。把范围外指令裁剪回范围内，还会产生超出这个简单上界的误差。
text.en: Consider an illustrative translation range from minus four to plus four centimeters. Divide it into eight equal bins and decode each bin to its center. Each bin is one centimeter wide, giving a maximum half-centimeter error inside the range. A requested one point two centimeters becomes one point five, an error of three millimeters. Increasing the bin count reduces this bound, but changes prediction difficulty and sequence design. Clipping an out-of-range command creates additional error beyond this simple bound.

title.zh: 自回归按顺序预测编码

text.zh: 自回归解码器根据观测和之前的 token，预测下一个 token。训练通常最小化示范 token 序列的负对数概率。各条件概率的乘积，定义了整段序列获得的概率。这种方式适合语言模型主干，但串行生成会形成一条依赖链。如果一个动作块包含很多维度和时间步，朴素分箱就可能产生很长的序列。所以 token 数量既是表示选择，也是系统工程问题。
text.en: An autoregressive decoder predicts the next token using the observation and previous tokens. Training commonly minimizes negative log probability of the demonstrated token sequence. The product of conditional probabilities defines the probability assigned to the entire sequence. This is convenient for language-model backbones, but serial generation creates a dependency chain. If a chunk contains many dimensions and timesteps, naive binning can produce a long sequence. Token count is thus a systems issue as well as a representational choice.

title.zh: FAST 利用时间结构压缩动作

text.zh: FAST 处理的是：每一时刻、每个动作维度分别编码所产生的冗余。沿着原图从左向右看，首先输入的是归一化动作块。离散余弦变换，把各动作通道表示成沿时间变化的频率分量。这些系数随后被量化、序列化，再通过字节对编码进一步压缩。解码时逆转这个过程，还原连续动作序列。因此，平滑且相关的动作，与任意独立采样的动作，可以具有不同的编码长度。
text.en: FAST addresses the redundancy of representing every action dimension at every timestep separately. Follow its original figure from left to right, starting with a normalized action chunk. A discrete cosine transform expresses each action channel using frequency components across time. The coefficients are quantized and serialized, then compressed further with byte-pair encoding. Decoding reverses the process to recover a continuous action sequence. Smooth, correlated motion can therefore use a different code length than arbitrary independent samples.

title.zh: 压缩率不等于策略能力

text.zh: 分词器可能准确还原已记录动作，但策略仍然难以预测正确编码。这是不同的测量：重建检验表示，实际运行检验学习到的控制策略。FAST 是动作分词器，本身不是一个完整的机器人策略。使用 FAST 的模型，仍然需要观测、任务条件、训练数据，以及执行时序。同样，训练更快，并不能证明某台机器人上的端到端反应延迟更低。必须看清实际报告的量：压缩率、训练时间、动作吞吐，还是任务完成表现。
text.en: A tokenizer can reconstruct recorded motions accurately while the policy predicts its codes poorly. Reconstruction tests the representation; rollout tests the behavior of the learned policy. FAST is an action tokenizer, not a complete robot policy by itself. A model using FAST still needs observations, task conditioning, training data, and an execution schedule. Likewise, faster training does not prove lower end-to-end response latency on a particular robot. Always follow the reported quantity: compression, training time, action throughput, or task completion.

title.zh: 动作块组织时间上的行为

text.zh: 动作分块把多条未来指令，组合成一个预测问题。它可以减少重复决策，也有助于表示连贯动作，包括示范中的停顿。ACT 用 Transformer，并在训练中采用条件变分自编码器，来建模动作块。它的时间集成，会合并指向同一未来时间步的重叠预测。这与把一个动作块内所有未来时间步直接平均，并不是一回事。同时，动作分块可以搭配离散 token、连续回归、扩散，或者流匹配。
text.en: Action chunking groups several future commands into a single prediction problem. It can reduce repeated decisions and help represent coherent motions, including pauses in demonstrations. ACT uses a Transformer and a conditional variational autoencoder during training to model action chunks. Its temporal ensembling combines overlapping predictions referring to the same future timestep. This is distinct from taking the average of all future steps in one chunk. And chunking is compatible with discrete tokens, continuous regression, diffusion, or flow matching.

title.zh: 回归也是必须认真比较的基线

text.zh: 连续回归头直接预测数值动作，通常可以并行输出完整动作块。L1 目标惩罚预测动作与示范动作在各坐标上的绝对差值。L2 目标则惩罚平方差，因此对较大误差施加更大权重。OpenVLA-OFT 说明，在认真比较微调方案时，这类简单方法不能缺席。其方案结合了并行解码、动作分块、连续输出，以及 L1 回归。这个结果对应具体配置，并不证明回归在所有情况下都胜过生成式解码器。
text.en: A continuous regression head predicts numerical actions directly, often producing a full chunk in parallel. An L1 objective penalizes absolute coordinate differences from demonstrated actions. An L2 objective instead penalizes squared differences, which weights larger errors more strongly. OpenVLA-OFT shows why this simple family belongs in a serious comparison of fine-tuning recipes. Its recipe combines parallel decoding, action chunks, continuous outputs, and L1 regression. The result is a concrete configuration, not proof that regression universally beats every generative decoder.

title.zh: 为什么多个合理动作会让平均变危险
title.en: Why several valid motions complicate averaging

text.zh: 想象夹爪可以从障碍左侧，或者右侧，绕过去拿杯子。两种示范路线都能成功，但逐点平均后的路线可能直接穿过障碍。这个教学例子解释了：为什么多峰动作分布有时十分重要。确定性损失可能把不兼容的选择概括到一起，而不是选定一条连贯路线。生成式策略能够表示不同选择，但仍然需要成功的训练和采样。随机性或者看起来平滑的轨迹，都不是避免物理碰撞的保证。
text.en: Imagine that the gripper can reach the cup by moving left or right around an obstacle. Both demonstrated routes succeed, but their pointwise mean may pass straight through the obstacle. This teaching example explains why a multimodal action distribution can matter. A deterministic loss may summarize incompatible choices instead of committing to one coherent route. Generative policies can represent alternatives, although successful training and sampling are still required. Neither stochasticity nor a smooth-looking trajectory is a guarantee against physical collision.

title.zh: 扩散逐步修正含噪动作序列
title.en: Diffusion refines a noisy action sequence

text.zh: Diffusion Policy 在推理时，从一个含噪动作序列开始，反复进行修正。训练时，会在采样的噪声等级下，给示范动作加入已知噪声。网络在机器人观测条件下，学习一个去噪目标。部署时，采样过程利用这些学习到的信息，生成连贯动作块。这些修正步骤发生在模型推理内部，并不是机器人分别执行的物理动作。因此，测量指令可用之前的等待时间时，必须把这些计算成本算进去。
text.en: Diffusion Policy begins inference with a noisy action sequence and repeatedly refines it. During training, known noise is added to demonstrations at sampled noise levels. The network learns a denoising objective while conditioned on the robot's observations. At deployment, a sampling procedure uses this learned information to generate a coherent action chunk. The refinement steps happen inside inference; they are not separate physical actions of the robot. Their computational cost must therefore be included when measuring the time before commands become available.

title.zh: 把流匹配理解成一个速度场
title.en: Flow matching as a velocity field

text.zh: 在一种简单的流匹配构造中，我们在随机噪声与示范动作块之间插值。在插值时刻 tau，噪声权重是一减 tau，动作权重是 tau。沿这条直线路径的目标速度，就是动作块减去采样噪声。网络根据观测和插值时刻，学习这个速度。推理时，数值积分把噪声样本输运到学习到的动作分布附近。tau 描述的是生成过程中的计算进度，不是物理任务经过的秒数。
text.en: For a simple flow-matching construction, interpolate between random noise and a demonstrated action chunk. The network learns that velocity conditioned on observations and interpolation time. At inference, numerical integration transports a noise sample toward the learned action distribution. Tau describes generative computation, not the seconds elapsed in the physical task.

These descriptions explain mechanisms, but do not establish a universal speed ranking. Actual cost depends on model size, sequence length, sampling steps, caching, precision, and hardware. Keep these factors visible when someone attributes every improvement to a single architectural ingredient.

title.zh: 已经进入执行队列的动作块
title.en: The chunk that was already committed

text.zh: 现在，在机器人执行上一段动作块时，把杯子挪走。新生成动作，不能直接替换已经执行，或者确定即将执行的指令。如果两个动作块在交界处不一致，切换时就可能产生突然跳变。因此，选好解码器，并不意味着已经解决行为连续性问题。预测、队列管理和物理执行，必须对哪些时间戳仍可修改达成一致。部署章节会用一条移动时间轴，把这个不可随意修改的边界画清楚。

title.zh: 根据真实任务选择表示
title.en: Choose the representation for the actual task

text.zh: 实际比较时，先固定观测流程，并定义一份机器人动作接口约定。随后改变表示或解码器，同时尽量保持数据和评估预算可比。既测量任务完成情况，也测量影响杯子移动后纠正动作的各种延迟。还要检查失败轨迹，因为良好平均值可能掩盖抖动、忽略指令，或反应过晚。在获得这些证据之前，没有理由直接选择最复杂的解码器。下一章，我们用这些区分，理解机器人基础策略的主要路线。
text.en: For a practical comparison, freeze the observation pipeline and define one robot action contract first. Then vary the representation or decoder while keeping the data and evaluation budget comparable. Measure both task completion and the delays that affect correction of the moved cup. Inspect failure trajectories, because a good average can hide jitter, ignored instructions, or late reactions. There is no reason to select the most complicated decoder before this evidence exists. Next, we use these distinctions to understand the major families of robot foundation policies.

text.zh: 机器人基础策略，并不是沿着从小模型到大模型的一条直线发展。有些工作改进机器人专用架构，有些则迁移预训练视觉语言模型的语义知识。还有一些重视可复用机器人数据、灵活动作接口、高效适配，或者从部署中继续学习。我们将根据这些决定组织主要模型，而不是按一个醒目的成功率排名。同一个杯子任务作为理解参照，同时每篇论文保留自己的实验适用范围。比较时，我们会区分已发表机制，以及仍需在本地验证的能力。
text.en: Robot foundation policies did not develop along one straight line from small models to large ones. Some work improves robot-specific architectures; some transfers semantic knowledge from pretrained vision-language models. Others emphasize reusable robot data, flexible action interfaces, efficient adaptation, or learning from deployment. We will organize the major models by those decisions rather than by one headline success rate. The same cup task will serve as a reference, while each paper keeps its own experimental scope. Our comparison distinguishes published mechanisms from capabilities that still need local testing.

title.zh: RT-1：构建可扩展的机器人策略
title.en: RT-1: make a scalable robot policy

text.zh: RT-1 将语言条件图像处理，与预测离散机器人动作的 Transformer 结合。原图中，句子嵌入先调制视觉特征，随后再压缩视觉 token。TokenLearner 减少视觉表示的大小，然后时间信息进入 Transformer。这个设计强调：通过规模较大且多样的机器人示范数据，实现高效控制。它使用预训练视觉和语言组件，但这不等于直接适配大型 VLM 的方案。追问模型的语义知识和运动能力来自哪里时，这个区分十分重要。
text.en: RT-1 combines language-conditioned image processing with a Transformer that predicts discretized robot actions. In the original diagram, a sentence embedding modulates visual features before token reduction. TokenLearner reduces the visual representation before temporal information reaches the Transformer. This design places emphasis on efficient control from a substantial, diverse robot demonstration dataset. Its pretrained visual and language components do not make it the same recipe as adapting a large VLM. The distinction matters when asking where a model's semantic knowledge and motor competence originate.

title.zh: RT-2：把动作接进 VLM 的词汇
title.en: RT-2: actions become part of a VLM vocabulary

text.zh: RT-2 追问：预训练视觉语言模型，能否直接产生底层机器人动作？它把动作表示为 token 字符串，并共同微调机器人数据与网络视觉语言任务。论文研究的是来自 PaLI-X 和 PaLM-E 的不同版本，而不是一个通用架构。语义迁移可以帮助选择用某个概念描述的物体，即使机器人示范中未出现该概念。但这并不意味着机器人仅靠阅读网络，就学会了全新的物理技能。学习到的动作能力，仍然取决于机器人训练数据的分布。
text.en: RT-2 asks whether a pretrained vision-language model can directly produce low-level robot actions. It represents actions using token strings and co-fine-tunes on robot data and web vision-language tasks. The paper studies versions derived from PaLI-X and PaLM-E rather than one universal architecture. Semantic transfer can help select an object described through a concept absent from robot demonstrations. That does not imply the robot acquired an entirely new physical skill solely by reading the web. The learned action repertoire still depends on the robot training distribution.

title.zh: RT-X：在不同机器人之间共享经验

text.zh: Open X-Embodiment 用统一格式汇集机器人数据集，并研究跨形态训练。RT-1-X 和 RT-2-X 把更广泛的数据混合用于相关策略架构。重要变量不只是模型名字，还包括哪些机器人的经验进入了训练。如果相关视觉和动作结构能够迁移，一个平台上的技能可能帮助另一个平台。但是，统一文件格式，并不会消除夹爪、坐标、控制器或相机的差异。所以跨形态迁移需要测量，而不是把数据集拼在一起就必然发生。
text.en: Open X-Embodiment gathers robot datasets under a common format and studies cross-embodiment training. RT-1-X and RT-2-X apply that broader data mixture to related policy architectures. The important variable is not just the model name, but which robot experiences entered training. A skill observed on one platform may help another when relevant visual and action structure transfers. However, standardizing file formats does not erase differences in grippers, coordinates, controllers, or cameras. Cross-embodiment transfer is therefore something to measure, not a consequence guaranteed by concatenating datasets.

title.zh: OpenVLA：开放的 VLM 适配路线
title.en: OpenVLA: an accessible VLM adaptation route

text.zh: OpenVLA 将预训练 Prismatic 视觉语言模型，适配成开放发布的机器人策略。它的架构结合 DINOv2、SigLIP 视觉特征，以及 Llama 语言主干。原始版本预测离散动作 token，再把它们解码成连续机器人指令。研究还检验了对新配置的适配，包括参数高效微调。与 RT-2 的共同微调方案不同，其主要机器人适配阶段仅使用机器人动作数据。这个例子说明，相同术语背后，可能藏着不同的训练选择。
text.en: OpenVLA adapts a pretrained Prismatic vision-language model into an openly released robot policy. Its architecture combines DINOv2 and SigLIP visual features with a Llama language backbone. The original release predicts discretized action tokens and decodes them into continuous robot commands. The study also examines adaptation to new setups, including parameter-efficient fine-tuning. Unlike RT-2's co-fine-tuning recipe, its main robot adaptation uses robot action data alone. This is a useful example of why shared terminology can conceal different training choices.

title.zh: Octo：灵活输入与动作头
title.en: Octo: flexible inputs and action heads

text.zh: Octo 从可复用通用机器人策略的需求出发，而不是从大型对话模型出发。它可以通过语言或目标图像接收任务描述，也支持观测历史。原始结构将观测编码器、Transformer 主干，以及动作读出模块分开。扩散动作头建模动作块，而适配时可以引入新传感器或动作空间。看原图下半部分：部分接口发生变化，但预训练核心仍可复用。这让接口灵活性成为首要设计目标，而不是事后补丁。
text.en: Octo starts from the needs of a reusable generalist robot policy rather than a large conversational model. It accepts task descriptions through language or goal images and supports observation histories. The original architecture separates observation tokenizers, a Transformer backbone, and action readouts. A diffusion action head models action chunks, while adaptation can introduce new sensors or action spaces. Follow the lower half of the figure: some interfaces change while the pretrained core remains reusable. This makes interface flexibility a first-class design objective rather than an afterthought.

title.zh: SmolVLA：紧凑且开放的路线
title.en: SmolVLA: a compact and open route

text.zh: SmolVLA 将紧凑的预训练视觉语言模型，与流匹配动作专家结合。它通过减少视觉 token、使用主干中间层等选择，降低计算量。论文中的主要模型，大约包含四亿五千万个参数。其机器人预训练采用筛选后的社区数据集，然后针对评估配置进行适配。配套的异步系统，将模型推理与动作执行分开。较小参数量可以降低使用门槛，但不能单独决定真实机器人的延迟或成功率。
text.en: SmolVLA combines a compact pretrained vision-language model with a flow-matching action expert. It reduces computation through choices such as fewer visual tokens and using intermediate backbone layers. The paper's main model contains approximately four hundred fifty million parameters. Its robot pretraining uses curated community datasets, followed by adaptation for the evaluated settings. The accompanying asynchronous system separates model inference from action execution. Small parameter count can improve accessibility, but does not alone determine real robot latency or success.

title.zh: π0：通过流匹配生成连续动作
title.en: Pi-zero: continuous control through flow matching

text.zh: π0 在预训练视觉语言主干上，加入独立的连续动作专家。该专家根据图像、语言和机器人状态，通过流匹配生成动作块。训练结合多样机器人经验，以及后续针对高难任务的专门训练。由此产生两个不同的评估问题：基础策略能做什么，以及后训练又带来了什么。因此，出色的叠衣示范，也应标注实际训练和部署阶段。强大的语言主干，并不能替代这些物理任务经验。
text.en: Pi-zero augments a pretrained vision-language backbone with a separate continuous-action expert. That expert generates action chunks through flow matching, conditioned on images, language, and robot state. Training combines diverse robot experience with subsequent specialization for demanding tasks. This creates two different evaluation questions: what the base policy can do, and what post-training enables. An impressive folding demonstration should therefore be labeled with its actual training and deployment stage. The presence of a strong language backbone does not replace that physical task experience.

title.zh: π0.5：异构监督信号

text.zh: π0.5 把学习数据混合扩展到单一机器人动作监督之外。原论文结合异构数据源，同时预测高层子任务和底层动作。初始训练阶段使用离散动作 token，后续训练加入连续动作生成。执行时，选出的子任务会进一步限定机器人的具体动作。后续知识隔离研究，进一步改进主干与动作专家的共同学习方式。复现或者比较结果时，应区分原始模型和这个后续训练方案。
text.en: Pi-zero-point-five broadens the learning mixture beyond a single kind of robot action supervision. Its original paper combines heterogeneous sources and predicts high-level subtasks as well as low-level actions. The initial training stage uses discrete action tokens; later training adds continuous action generation. At execution, a selected subtask helps condition the detailed robot movement. The later knowledge-insulation study refines how the backbone and action expert learn together. Keep the original model and that later training recipe distinct when reproducing or comparing results.

title.zh: π*0.6：从部署经验中继续学习

text.zh: π*0.6 通过 RECAP 方法，在策略外围增加一条继续学习的循环。系统收集自主执行经验和人工纠正，再利用奖励信息改进行为。价值函数帮助估计哪些动作改善预期进展，从而支持优势条件训练。这超出了把每条已记录动作，都当成同样理想的模仿目标。星号表示经过经验改进的策略，因此比较标签中不应把它省掉。其评估包含可靠性与吞吐量，同时人工反馈仍然属于学习过程的一部分。
text.en: Pi-star-zero-point-six adds a learning loop around the policy through the RECAP method. The system collects autonomous experience and human corrections, then uses reward information to improve behavior. A value function helps estimate which actions improve expected progress, supporting advantage-conditioned training. This goes beyond simply treating every recorded action as an equally desirable imitation target. The star identifies the experience-improved policy, so it should not disappear from a comparison label. Its evaluation includes both reliability and throughput, with human feedback still part of the learning process.

In the original figure, the action policy consumes context produced by humans or additional model components. Richer steering can recombine learned skills, but it does not establish unlimited physical competence. We reserve the detailed prediction and planning mechanisms for the separate world-model course.

title.zh: 从瓶颈出发选择路线
title.en: Choose a route by the bottleneck

text.zh: 对于杯子任务，选择模型家族之前，先诊断瓶颈。如果语言被忽略，应调查语言落地与训练监督，而不只是加快动作采样。如果机器人接口改变，应检查可适配输入、动作头，以及目标平台示范。如果动作总是过时，应把部署时序与网络架构放在一起分析。如果重复物理错误占主导，就要看训练过程实际利用了哪些纠错经验。下一章，我们将沿着这些问题，进入数据记录、监督与跨形态训练。
text.en: For our cup task, first diagnose the bottleneck before selecting a model family. If language is ignored, investigate grounding and training supervision, not merely faster action sampling. If the robot interface changes, examine adaptable inputs, action heads, and available target demonstrations. If motion becomes stale, investigate the deployment timeline alongside the network architecture. If repeated physical errors dominate, consider what corrective experience the training process actually uses. The next chapter follows these ideas into data records, supervision, and cross-embodiment training.

title.zh: 示范是一条同步记录
title.en: A demonstration is a synchronized record

text.zh: 训练示范，不只是附带任务标题的一段视频。它包含观测、机器人状态、动作、时间戳，以及回合相关信息。对于杯子任务，学习器必须知道每种观测情境对应哪条指令。如果图像时间与动作时间发生偏移，正确示范也可能变成误导性监督。策略可能学到接触前就闭合夹爪，或者朝物体先前的位置运动。因此，数据工程改变的是学习问题本身，而不只是文件读取是否方便。
text.en: A training demonstration is not simply a video with a task title attached. It contains observations, robot state, actions, timestamps, and information about the episode. For our cup task, the learner must know which command corresponds to each observed situation. If image timing and action timing drift apart, a correct demonstration can become misleading supervision. The policy may learn to close the gripper before contact or move toward a previous object position. Data engineering therefore changes the learning problem itself, not just the convenience of loading files.

title.zh: 指令动作与实测状态不同
title.en: Commanded actions and measured states differ

text.zh: 假设操作者要求夹爪移动，但接触阻止它到达目标。此时，指令参考与机器人实测位置，描述的是不同的量。数据集必须说明：哪一个量是动作标签，哪一个量是观测。在 ACT 原始系统中，主手关节位置提供动作，从手机器人关节提供观测。把两者互相替换，可能改变策略对施力和接触的学习。仅仅写着关节位置，并不能解决这种区分。
text.en: Suppose a human commands a gripper to move, but contact prevents it from reaching the target. The commanded reference and the measured robot position now describe different quantities. A dataset must specify which quantity is the action label and which is an observation. In ACT's original setup, leader joint positions provide actions while follower joints provide observations. Replacing one with the other can change what the policy learns about effort and contact. The name joint position alone does not resolve this distinction.

title.zh: 训练之前先建立数据字典
title.en: Use a data dictionary before training

text.zh: 对每个动作字段，记录单位、参考系、绝对或相对含义，以及有效范围。还要说明姿态怎样编码，以及夹爪的打开和闭合如何表示。对每个相机，记录身份、预处理、可用标定信息，以及时间戳约定。腕部相机与房间相机，不能在不同数据集中悄悄交换名字。这些定义让适配层能够保留语义，而不只是保证张量形状一致。当新的机器人形态加入训练混合时，它们也有助于复现失败。
text.en: For every action field, record units, reference frame, absolute or relative meaning, and valid range. Also specify how orientation is encoded and what open or closed means for the gripper. For every camera, record its identity, preprocessing, calibration information when available, and timestamp convention. A wrist camera and a room camera should not silently exchange names between datasets. These definitions make it possible to write adapters that preserve semantics instead of merely tensor shapes. They also make failures reproducible when a new embodiment enters the training mixture.

title.zh: 归一化必须可还原且可追溯
title.en: Normalization must be reversible and versioned

text.zh: 许多策略会先归一化动作值，让不同坐标具有可比较的数值尺度。举个教学例子：用四厘米去除一个位移，得到归一化数值。两厘米指令变成零点五，而解码必须恢复原来的物理单位。实际实现也可能使用统计量、分位数、裁剪，或者针对不同字段的规则。保存的归一化元数据，必须与权重以及所选机器人数据集匹配。套用另一个数据集的统计量，可能在指令到达控制器前，就破坏看似合理的预测。
text.en: Many policies normalize action values before learning so coordinates have comparable numerical scales. As a teaching example, divide a displacement by four centimeters to obtain a normalized value. A two-centimeter command becomes zero point five, and decoding must recover the original physical unit. Actual implementations may use statistics, quantiles, clipping, or field-specific rules instead. The saved normalization metadata must match the checkpoint and the selected robot dataset. Applying another dataset's statistics can corrupt otherwise plausible predictions before they reach the controller.

title.zh: 共享数据集里仍然是不同身体
title.en: Shared datasets still contain different bodies

text.zh: Open X-Embodiment 原图展示了机器人平台、场景、技能和物体的多样性。这些维度很有价值，但它们不能互相替代，作为覆盖程度的指标。一台机械臂上的大量轨迹，并不等于很多不同机器人形态或环境。统一数据格式支持共享，但策略仍然需要兼容或者可适配的接口。抓取几何或动作语义不同时，朴素混合可能产生互相冲突的训练目标。因此，应检查模型实际使用的数据混合，而不是沿用整个集合的宣传规模。
text.en: The Open X-Embodiment figure shows diversity across robot platforms, scenes, skills, and objects. Those axes are valuable, but they are not interchangeable measures of coverage. Many trajectories on one arm do not equal many distinct embodiments or environments. A common dataset format enables sharing; the policy still needs compatible or adaptable interfaces. When grasp geometry or action semantics differ, naive mixing may create conflicting training targets. We should inspect the actual mixture used by a model rather than inherit the collection's full headline size.

text.zh: DROID 的重点有所不同：用统一机器人平台，在多样真实环境中收集数据。原始硬件图展示了机械臂、夹爪、外部相机、腕部相机，以及采集设备。统一硬件减少了部分接口差异，同时保留场景和任务的多样性。采集系统包含可穿戴遥操作设备，但这并不规定之后每个策略的输入。如果人类界面只用摄像头，可以改变采集方式，同时保持机器人数据记录约定。采集硬件、策略观测，以及评估硬件，需要分别说明。
text.en: DROID follows a different emphasis: a shared robot platform collects data in varied real environments. Its original hardware figure shows the arm, gripper, external cameras, wrist camera, and collection equipment. Standardizing hardware reduces some interface variation while retaining diversity in scenes and tasks. The collection system includes wearable teleoperation equipment; that does not define every later policy's input. For a camera-only human interface, our collection method can differ while preserving the robot record contract. Collection hardware, policy observations, and evaluation hardware must be described separately.

title.zh: 行为克隆拟合示范中的决策

text.zh: 行为克隆让策略对示范动作赋予高概率，或者产生较低预测误差。具体损失取决于表示：token 概率、回归误差，或者生成式训练目标。这些目标都由训练数据中，与观测配对的动作提供监督。较低训练损失表示更好地拟合该目标，并不必然表示物理任务完成得更好。部署时，策略自身的误差可能让系统进入示范中很少出现的状态。这种分布偏移，是恢复行为需要专门数据和评估的一个原因。
text.en: Behavior cloning trains the policy to assign high likelihood, or low error, to demonstrated actions. The loss depends on the representation: token likelihood, regression error, or a generative training objective. All are supervised by actions associated with observations in the training data. A lower training loss means better fit under that objective, not necessarily better physical task completion. During deployment, the policy's own errors can produce states that the demonstrations rarely visited. The resulting distribution shift is one reason recovery behavior needs explicit data and evaluation.

title.zh: 网络知识与机器人经验监督不同能力
title.en: Web knowledge and robot experience supervise different things

text.zh: 图文预训练可以学习物体、词语和视觉情境之间的关联。机器人示范则把观测和指令，连接到特定身体上能够执行的动作序列。一句拿起杯子的描述，并不提供机器人经过标定的关节轨迹。反过来，所有指令都相同的动作数据集，对语言选择提供的监督可能很弱。π0.5 原图展示了不同数据源在训练与推理中的不同角色。理解这些角色，比把所有样本加成一个不加区分的数据总数，更有信息量。
text.en: Image-text pretraining can teach associations among objects, words, and visual situations. Robot demonstrations connect observations and instructions to executable action sequences on particular bodies. A caption saying grasp the cup does not provide the robot's calibrated joint trajectory. Conversely, a dataset of motions with identical instructions may provide weak supervision for language choice. The pi-zero-point-five figure shows distinct data sources entering different training and inference roles. Understanding these roles is more informative than adding every sample into one undifferentiated data count.

title.zh: 人类视频没有直接给出机器人真值
title.en: Human video does not contain robot ground truth

text.zh: 人类视频可以扩展现有机器人示范之外的物体和行为覆盖。不过，可见的人手，并不是对另一台机器人电机指令的直接测量。学习系统必须说明连接方式：视觉目标、估计运动、潜在动作，或者其他信号。估计出来的标签，也会携带估计过程中的假设与误差。在 GR00T 的异构训练中，不同监督形式的数据源，通过明确建模选择来处理。把所有这些信号都叫作真值，反而会掩盖我们需要跟踪的不确定性。
text.en: Human videos can expand coverage of objects and behaviors beyond existing robot demonstrations. But the visible human hand is not a direct measurement of another robot's motor command. A learning system must specify its bridge: visual objectives, estimated motion, latent actions, or another signal. Estimated labels carry the assumptions and errors of the estimation process. In GR00T's heterogeneous training, data sources with different supervision are handled through explicit modeling choices. Calling all such signals ground truth would hide exactly the uncertainty we need to track.

title.zh: 混合权重决定模型反复练习什么
title.en: Mixture weights define what the model practices

text.zh: 在一个教学例子中，数据集 A 的帧数是数据集 B 的九倍。对全部帧均匀采样，会让 A 大约占据百分之九十的训练样本。在数据集之间等比例采样，则会在不新增数据的情况下，提高 B 的影响力。两种选择都不是普遍正确的；它们分别定义了不同的有效训练分布。重复静止帧、较长回合，以及重复示范，也会扭曲表面上的覆盖程度。解释消融实验时，应把采样与过滤方式，和数据集名字一起报告。
text.en: Suppose dataset A has nine times as many frames as dataset B in a teaching example. Uniform sampling over all frames gives A roughly ninety percent of the training examples. Equal sampling between datasets gives B much more influence without collecting any new data. Neither choice is universally correct; each defines a different effective training distribution. Repeated idle frames, long episodes, and duplicated demonstrations can similarly distort apparent coverage. Report sampling and filtering alongside dataset names when interpreting an ablation.

title.zh: 知识隔离区分梯度路径

text.zh: 知识隔离研究：新动作专家怎样学习，同时减少对预训练主干的干扰。主干通过离散动作和通用视觉语言数据，获得基于 token 的监督。动作专家学习连续动作生成，但其梯度在进入主干之前被截断。请看原图的梯度截断边界：它改变了哪个损失更新哪些参数。这不意味着整个主干被冻结，也不意味着动作学习消失。推理时，可以使用连续动作专家，而不生成训练时的离散动作序列。
text.en: Knowledge insulation addresses how a new action expert can learn without disrupting the pretrained backbone. The backbone receives token-based supervision from discretized actions and general vision-language data. The action expert learns continuous generation, but its gradients are stopped before entering the backbone. Look for the stop-gradient boundary in the original figure; it changes which loss updates which parameters. This does not mean that the entire backbone is frozen or that action learning disappears. At inference, the continuous expert can be used without generating the training-time discrete action sequence.

title.zh: 适配不只是选择 LoRA
title.en: Adaptation is more than choosing LoRA

text.zh: 微调选择包括更新哪些参数、使用哪些数据，以及预测哪一种接口。低秩适配可以减少可训练参数，但不能修复不一致的动作标签。新的相机视角，与新的夹爪或者新的接触任务，可能需要不同的数据证据。OpenVLA-OFT 进一步说明，除了参数效率，动作头与损失的变化也很重要。用验证集选择这些方案，再在未使用过的测试条件上评估最终系统。否则，对着测试集反复调整，会让评估变成未报告的训练阶段。
text.en: Fine-tuning choices include which parameters to update, which data to use, and which interface to predict. Low-rank adaptation can reduce trainable parameters, but it does not repair inconsistent action labels. A new camera viewpoint may require different evidence than a new gripper or a new contact task. OpenVLA-OFT further shows that changing the action head and loss can matter alongside parameter efficiency. Reserve validation data to select these choices, then evaluate the selected system on untouched test conditions. Otherwise, repeated tuning against the test set can turn evaluation into an unreported training stage.

title.zh: 数据切分应与泛化主张一致
title.en: Split episodes, environments, and claims together

text.zh: 随机切分相邻帧，可能让几乎相同的画面同时进入训练集和测试集。这与留出完整回合、物体，或者环境，测试的并不是同一种能力。应根据主张选择切分：新场景、新指令、新物体，或者新机器人形态。归一化统计与模型选择，也必须限制在允许使用的训练和验证数据内。记录排除项和失败，因为悄悄删除困难回合，会改变问题本身。诚实的数据切分，精确定义了最终泛化结果能够支持什么结论。
text.en: Randomly splitting neighboring frames can place almost identical views in training and testing. That does not test the same capability as withholding complete episodes, objects, or environments. Choose the split according to the claim: new scene, new instruction, new object, or new embodiment. Keep normalization statistics and model selection within the allowed training and validation data. Record exclusions and failures, because silently discarding difficult episodes changes the problem. An honest split defines precisely what the final reported generalization can support.

title.zh: 一份可复现的训练交接

text.zh: 训练之前，建立一份紧凑清单，把数据集、变换与权重连接起来。其中包含动作约定、时间对齐、相机映射、过滤、混合权重，以及切分标识。接着记录训练目标，以及每项损失可以更新哪些参数。对于杯子任务，这能帮助区分策略表现不佳，还是单位错误、相机标签错误。由此产生的权重，才是可复现系统的一部分，而不是孤立的参数文件。下一章，我们把这个系统放入实时运行，让计算与物理运动真正发生交叠。
text.en: Before training, assemble a compact manifest linking each dataset, transformation, and checkpoint. Include action conventions, timestamp alignment, camera mapping, filtering, mixture weights, and split identifiers. Then document the objective and which parameters each loss is allowed to update. For the cup task, this lets us distinguish a poor policy from a wrong unit or mislabeled camera. The resulting checkpoint becomes one part of a reproducible system, rather than an isolated weight file. Next we bring that system into real time, where computation and physical motion overlap.

summary.zh: 用时间轴拆解延迟、异步队列与 RTC，再逐层诊断相机遥操作、自主策略和真实执行中的失败。
summary.en: Connect policy inference to latency, queues, closed-loop correction and adaptation.

title.zh: 模型推理时，世界不会暂停
title.en: The world does not pause during inference

text.zh: 模型仍在处理上一帧图像时，杯子已经移动了。即使对那幅图像的预测是正确的，也可能已经不适用于当前物理情境。实时部署要追问：信息何时采集、动作何时生成，以及何时执行。这些时间戳，把计算过程与机器人周围持续变化的世界连接起来。在暂停式仿真中表现良好的策略，在物理时间持续流逝时，可能表现不同。因此，我们把时序视为部署策略的一部分，而不是装饰性的性能指标。
text.en: The cup moves while the model is still processing the previous image. Even a correct prediction for that image may now describe the wrong physical situation. Real-time deployment asks when information was captured, when actions were generated, and when they execute. These timestamps connect computation to the changing world around the robot. A policy that performs well with paused simulation can behave differently when physical time keeps running. We therefore treat timing as part of the deployed policy, not a cosmetic performance statistic.

title.zh: 把真正发生的延迟加起来
title.en: Add the delays that actually occur

text.zh: 考虑一个简化的串行例子：采集和预处理延迟四十毫秒。假设推理再用一百二十毫秒，之后又在动作队列中等待八十毫秒。最终第一条指令使用的信息，就已经是二百四十毫秒之前的了。这个加法是教学例子，不是对任何一个模型的延迟测量。在异步系统中，部分区间会重叠，因此必须根据真实时间图进行计算。只报告神经网络推理时间，会漏掉影响延迟纠正的重要来源。
text.en: Consider a simplified serial example with forty milliseconds of capture and preprocessing delay. Suppose inference then takes one hundred twenty milliseconds, followed by eighty milliseconds in an action queue. The first resulting command uses information that is already two hundred forty milliseconds old. This sum is a teaching example, not a latency measurement of any named model. In an asynchronous system, some intervals overlap, so the real timing diagram must determine the calculation. Reporting only neural-network inference time would miss important sources of delayed correction.

title.zh: 同步动作分块会产生停顿

text.zh: 简单同步系统先预测一个动作块，执行它，然后等待下一次预测。在等待区间内，即使示范动作是平滑连续的，机器人也可能停下来。停顿改变了物理轨迹，对于动态接触或运动物体，可能产生重要影响。增加执行时域，可以减少停顿次数，却也会延长不接受新反馈的执行承诺。缩短执行时域，可以增加接受反馈的机会，但也会增加推理需求。这是部署中的权衡，不是选用动作分块这个术语就能解决的问题。
text.en: A simple synchronous system predicts a chunk, executes it, and then waits for the next prediction. During this waiting interval, the robot may stop even when demonstrations contained smooth continuous motion. That pause changes the physical trajectory and can matter for dynamic contact or moving objects. Increasing the execution horizon can reduce how often the system pauses, but prolongs open-loop commitment. Shortening it can improve opportunities for feedback while increasing inference demands. This is a deployment tradeoff, not something solved by choosing the word chunking.

title.zh: 异步推理让计算与动作重叠
title.en: Asynchronous inference overlaps computation and motion

text.zh: 在异步系统中，机器人执行排队动作，同时另一个进程预测后续动作。SmolVLA 原图把机器人客户端与策略服务器分开。在当前队列清空前发送新观测，让推理与执行发生重叠。响应到达时，系统必须把它与仍然有效的后续动作对齐。否则，一个数值上有效的动作块，可能仍从机器人已经离开的状态出发。异步消除了一部分等待，但不会消除观测年龄，也不保证切换平滑。
text.en: In an asynchronous system, the robot executes queued actions while another process predicts future ones. SmolVLA's original diagram separates the robot client from the policy server. A new observation is sent before the current queue empties, allowing inference to overlap execution. When the response arrives, the system must align it with the actions that remain relevant. Otherwise, a numerically valid chunk may start from a state the robot has already left. Asynchrony removes some waiting, but does not erase observation age or guarantee smooth switching.

title.zh: 把推理延迟换算成已确定执行的步数
title.en: Convert inference delay into committed steps

text.zh: 再用一个教学例子：控制器每秒更新五十次。每个动作步占用二十毫秒，模型推理需要一百二十毫秒。于是，在这次推理期间，大约有六个排队动作步会被执行。如果新预测涉及这些相同时间戳，它们的数值就不再能够自由替换。系统应区分已执行历史、已确定执行的近期动作，以及仍可修改的未来后缀。这种区分，让队列管理成为时间一致性问题，而不只是向列表追加元素。
text.en: Use another teaching example: a controller runs at fifty updates per second. Each action step occupies twenty milliseconds, and inference takes one hundred twenty milliseconds. Roughly six queued steps will execute while that inference is running. If a new prediction describes those same timestamps, their values are no longer freely replaceable. The system should distinguish executed history, committed near-future actions, and a still-editable future suffix. That distinction makes queue management a temporal consistency problem rather than a simple list append.

title.zh: RTC 让下一段适应已确定执行的前缀
title.en: RTC conditions the next chunk on its committed prefix

text.zh: 实时动作分块，把下一段动作的生成视为带约束的补全问题。近期前缀由推理完成前就会执行的动作引导。其余后缀则能够适应最新观测，包括被挪动的杯子。原始时间图显示：已确定执行动作附近引导更强，越远的未来引导越弱。这样既鼓励动作块平滑衔接，又为新的纠正保留空间。这是针对扩散或流策略的具体推理方法，并不是所有延迟问题的通用解药。
text.en: Real-time chunking treats generation of the next action chunk as a constrained inpainting problem. The near-future prefix is guided by actions that will execute before inference can finish. The remaining suffix can adapt to the latest observation, including the moved cup. The original timeline shows stronger guidance near committed actions and weaker guidance farther into the future. This encourages compatible chunk transitions while retaining room for new corrections. It is a specific inference method for diffusion or flow policies, not a universal cure for all latency.

title.zh: 测量完整系统，也看延迟尾部
title.en: Measure the whole stack, including the tail

text.zh: 把采集到指令的延迟、动作吞吐量，以及任务时长，作为不同的量测量。记录机器人、推理硬件、数值精度、相机分辨率，以及批大小。还要记录动作块长度、执行步数、网络传输，以及模型输入是否缓存。较低平均延迟，可能掩盖偶发停顿；这些停顿会破坏接触，或者耗尽动作队列。应检查延迟分布和错过的期限，而不仅是预热后最好的一次推理。仅靠参数量，无法还原这些运行测量。
text.en: Measure capture-to-command delay, action throughput, and task duration as different quantities. Record the robot, inference hardware, numerical precision, camera resolution, and batch size. Also record chunk length, executed steps, network transport, and whether model inputs are cached. A low average latency can hide occasional stalls that break contact or empty the action queue. Inspect the latency distribution and missed deadlines, not only the best warmed-up inference call. Parameter count alone cannot recover any of these operational measurements.

title.zh: 仅用摄像头，也仍需机器人接口
title.en: Camera-only control still needs a robot interface

text.zh: 对于仅用摄像头的人类界面，可以不戴手套或跟踪器，直接观察操作者。这个选择描述的是人类观测，并不会移除机器人的关节编码器或控制器。也并不是每个 VLA 都会自动把可见人类动作，转换成所需机器人动作。直接自主策略遵循其任务条件，而遥操作需要额外的意图接口。如果用相机观察运动来采集示范，其估计必须映射到记录动作的接口约定。设计实验或标注演示时，应把这些运行模式分清楚。
text.en: For a camera-only human interface, we can observe the operator without gloves or wearable trackers. That choice describes human observation; it does not remove the robot's joint encoders or controller. Nor does every VLA automatically turn visible human motion into a desired robot action. A direct autonomous policy follows its task conditioning, while teleoperation requires an additional intent interface. If camera motion is used for demonstrations, its estimates must be mapped into the recorded action contract. Keep these modes separate when designing an experiment or labeling a demonstration.

title.zh: 在正确层级诊断失败
title.en: Diagnose failures at the correct layer

text.zh: 机器人抓空杯子时，先检查完整链路，不要立刻归咎于动作生成器。指令是否指定了正确杯子，图像是否提供了足够的定位证据？动作单位与坐标是否正确，控制器是否追踪了解码后的参考？参考是否仍然有效，还是来自杯子移动之前采集的观测？最后，即使接近动作看起来合适，真实接触是否仍然失败？这些问题对应不同改进措施，避免一个失败标签掩盖多种原因。
text.en: When the robot misses the cup, inspect the full chain before blaming the action generator. Did the instruction identify the intended cup, and did the image contain enough evidence to locate it? Were action units and frames correct, and did the controller track the decoded reference? Was the reference current, or was it based on an observation captured before the cup moved? Finally, did physical contact fail despite an apparently appropriate reaching motion? These questions produce different interventions and prevent one failure label from hiding several causes.

title.zh: 恢复能力应当被专门测量
title.en: Recovery should be a measured capability

text.zh: 原作者精选视频可以展示恢复曾经发生，却不能说明恢复有多可靠。这里的 OpenVLA 例子，展示了一次杯子交互不顺利之后的重新尝试。它是有价值的定性证据，我们会清楚标出原片播放速度。要测量恢复，应定义扰动内容、发生时刻、允许时间，以及成功条件。随后在可比重置条件下重复试验，并保留成功与失败结果。一次重试如果最终摔落杯子，不能因为看起来有适应性，就算作成功恢复。
text.en: A selected author video can show that recovery happened, but cannot tell us how reliably it happens. The OpenVLA example shown here contains a reattempt after an unsuccessful interaction with a cup. It is useful qualitative evidence, with the original playback speed clearly labeled. title.zh: 流畅解说之外，还要有运行边界
title.en: Operational boundaries belong outside fluent narration

text.zh: 部署系统需要明确规定：观测丢失、推理停顿，或者指令无效时，该怎么做。根据硬件和任务不同，可能采取受控保持、中止，或者人工介入。这些选择应在真实控制器上实现和测试，而不是从模型置信度推断。高置信度 token 预测，并不是经过校准的碰撞风险或抓取稳定性估计。发生介入时应记录下来，并在评估协议中明确它的角色。否则，看似自主的运行，可能悄悄依赖了未报告的帮助。
text.en: A deployed system needs explicit behavior when observations disappear, inference stalls, or commands become invalid. Depending on the hardware and task, that may involve a controlled hold, abort, or operator intervention. Those choices should be implemented and tested with the actual controller rather than inferred from model confidence. A confident token prediction is not a calibrated estimate of collision risk or grasp stability. Log when an intervention occurs and count its role in the evaluation protocol. Otherwise, an apparently autonomous rollout can quietly depend on unreported assistance.

text.zh: 如果失败总发生在杯子移动之后，增加静态示范未必能解决原因。应先检查时序和接口，再收集覆盖相关纠正或恢复状态的数据。监督微调可以学习纠正示范，而失败经验则需要合适的处理方式。RECAP 展示了如何把价值与优势信息，同执行经验和人工纠正结合。原始学习循环图，区分了数据收集、价值学习，以及策略改进。这是一套额外训练流程，不是打开日志记录就会自动出现的能力。
text.en: If failures repeatedly occur after the cup moves, additional static demonstrations may not address the cause. First check timing and interfaces, then collect data covering the relevant correction or recovery states. Supervised fine-tuning can learn from corrected demonstrations, but unsuccessful experience needs appropriate treatment. RECAP provides an example of using value and advantage information alongside experience and human corrections. The original learning-loop figure separates data collection, value learning, and policy improvement. This is an additional training procedure, not a capability that appears merely by turning on logging.

title.zh: 把推理到任务完成之间的阶段分开
title.en: Stage the transition from inference to a task

text.zh: 产生有限数值的动作张量，是接口检查，不是机器人任务成功的证明。对录制观测回放，可以发现明显错误，却无法暴露闭环分布偏移。仿真可以在其假设下运行控制环，但这些假设仍与物理硬件不同。真实执行随后把接触、感知、延迟和扰动放在一起检验。短暂提起杯子所证明的内容，少于把它搬运、放置并释放到指定位置。准确标记每个阶段，才能让进展有用，又不夸大完成程度。
text.en: Producing a finite action tensor is an interface check, not proof of a successful robot task. Playback against recorded observations can reveal gross errors, but does not expose closed-loop distribution shift. A simulator can exercise the control loop under its assumptions, which still differ from physical hardware. Real execution then tests contact, sensing, delays, and disturbances together. A short lift establishes less than transporting, placing, and releasing the cup at the requested location. Label each stage precisely so progress remains useful without overstating completion.

title.zh: 用可测量的系统真正闭环
title.en: Close the loop with a measured system

text.zh: 到这里，被挪动杯子的例子，已经有了一套完整部署解释。观测到达时已有一定年龄，模型生成带时间关系的动作块，队列再确定执行。控制器执行这些参考，同时新测量带来纠正机会。只有记录足够信息来定位原因，失败才会变成有诊断价值的数据。所以，可部署模型实际上包含模型、接口、调度，以及经过验证的运行流程。最后一章，我们将讨论如何把这个完整系统，与有意义的基线公平比较。
text.en: Our moved-cup example now has a complete deployment explanation. The observation arrives with an age, the model produces a timed chunk, and the queue commits actions. The controller realizes those references, while new measurements create opportunities for correction. Failures become diagnostic data only when we record enough information to locate their cause. A deployable model is therefore a model plus interfaces, scheduling, and a verified operating procedure. The final chapter asks how to compare that complete system fairly against meaningful baselines.

title.zh: 什么才算有效证据？

text.zh: 两段视频都显示机器人成功放杯子，但它们可能回答完全不同的问题。一个策略可能专门针对该场景训练，另一个则面对留出的新环境。一个片段可能隐藏重置过程，另一个则包含每次尝试和人工介入。要比较系统，首先定义任务、输入、训练权限、执行条件，以及评分规则。只有这样，成功数字才可能指向同一个问题。这一章把前面学习的机制，转化成一份结果能够解释的评估方案。
text.en: Two videos show robots placing a cup successfully, but they may answer very different questions. One policy might be trained for that exact scene; another might face a held-out environment. One clip might hide resets, while another includes every attempt and intervention. To compare systems, we first define the task, inputs, training access, execution conditions, and scoring rule. Only then can success numbers refer to a shared question. This chapter turns the mechanisms we studied into an evaluation plan with interpretable outcomes.

title.zh: 运行之前，定义完整杯子任务
title.en: Define the whole cup task before running it

text.zh: 对于教学任务，我们要求指定杯子最终位于指定托盘内部。机器人必须释放杯子，让它保持稳定，并在预先声明的时间限制内完成。还要定义掉落、抓错物体、超时，或者人工介入之后怎样计分。单纯提起杯子，只能证明中间事件发生，不能证明完整指令完成。这些条件是我们的示例协议，并不是所有已发表基准都采用的统一规则。提前写明规则，可以防止一次漂亮的局部行为，在试验之后改变任务目标。
text.en: For our teaching task, require the specified cup to finish inside the requested tray. The robot must release it, leave it stable, and finish within the declared time limit. Also define what happens after a drop, wrong-object grasp, timeout, or human intervention. A lift alone establishes only an intermediate event, not completion of the full instruction. These criteria are our illustrative protocol, not a universal rule used by all published benchmarks. Writing them down first prevents an attractive partial behavior from changing the goal after the trial.

title.zh: 严格成功与部分进展是不同指标
title.en: Strict success and partial progress are different metrics

text.zh: 任务可以获得部分得分，同时仍未满足严格完成条件。π0 原始评估图，对几种多阶段任务报告的是平均任务进展。把柱状图读成二元成功率之前，先看清纵轴。在四个等权阶段的教学例子中，完成三个阶段，进展分数就是百分之七十五。如果没有完成稳定释放，同一次试验的严格成功仍然可以是零。两种测量都可以有价值，前提是分开标注，并保留各自定义。
text.en: A task can earn partial credit without satisfying the strict completion condition. The original pi-zero evaluation figure reports average task progress for several multistage activities. If stable release is missing, strict success for that same trial can still be zero. Both measurements can be useful, provided they remain separately labeled and their definitions are preserved.

title.zh: 选择能够回答问题的基线
title.en: Choose baselines that answer the intended question

text.zh: 有意义的基线集合，不应只包含名字醒目的其他大模型。应包含从零训练且适合任务的策略，例如在适用条件下使用 ACT 或 Diffusion Policy。再在明确适配预算，以及兼容机器人接口下，比较预训练通用策略。如果测试要求根据不同语言指令选择目标，基线必须获得可比的任务信息。无条件专用策略可以单独评估，但悄悄不给它指令，会变成另一个问题。基线的角色，应说明这项比较究竟能够检验什么假设。
text.en: A meaningful baseline set should include more than other large models with impressive names. Include a task-appropriate policy trained from scratch, such as ACT or Diffusion Policy when applicable. Then compare pretrained generalists under a stated adaptation budget and a compatible robot interface. If the test requires choosing between language instructions, a baseline must receive comparable task information. An unconditioned specialist can be evaluated separately, but silently denying it the instruction creates a different problem. The baseline's role should explain what hypothesis the comparison can test.

title.zh: 比较分数之前，先匹配接口

text.zh: 检查观测相机、图像预处理、状态输入、动作坐标、夹爪约定，以及控制频率。还要检查，在新观测能够改变行为之前，会执行多少个预测动作。强模型如果连接了错误归一化适配器，就不是对其能力的公平检验。某些架构需要不同的原生配置，强迫完全相同设置，也可能损害某种方法。因此，应同时报告共同评估约定，以及满足约定所需的方法专用调整。公平意味着公开有意义的差异，而不是假装所有实现完全相同。
text.en: Check observation cameras, image preprocessing, state inputs, action coordinates, gripper conventions, and control frequency. Also check how many predicted actions are executed before another observation can change behavior. A strong model connected through a wrong normalization adapter is not a fair test of its capability. Some architectures need different native configurations; forcing identical settings can also handicap a method. Report both the common evaluation contract and any method-specific adjustments required to meet it. Fairness means making meaningful differences explicit, not pretending all implementations are identical.

title.zh: 记录次数、不确定性与人工介入

text.zh: 十次成功八次，与一百次成功八十次，观测成功率都是百分之八十。但对于真实成功概率，它们提供的证据量并不相同。应报告成功次数与总次数、不同种子或重置间的变化，以及合适的不确定性估计。除非协议明确排除，否则不能悄悄删除崩溃、超时，或者人工救场。在相同环境中重复试验时，还要考虑结果是否具有足够独立性。只有底层试验账目清楚可见，一个漂亮百分比才真正有用。

title.zh: 消融实验应该隔离一个主张

Knowledge Insulation provides a concrete example where stopping one gradient path is the hypothesis of interest. title.zh: 吞吐量引入了另一个分母

This remains separate from action-generation throughput, which counts model outputs rather than completed tasks.

title.zh: 一份实用的 DoF 基线报告

text.zh: 有用的报告，首先写明任务约定，以及被评估系统的确切版本。随后列出各基线的观测、动作格式、训练数据权限、适配，以及执行时序。把严格成功、部分进展、延迟和吞吐量，放在不同列中，并明确分母。保留有代表性的成功与失败，并让每个机制主张对应合适的消融实验。这样，杯子例子就成为一个小型可复现研究，而不只是又一段孤立演示。这就是如何把模型知识，转化为构建和改进真实机器人系统所需要的认知基础。
text.en: A useful report begins with the task contract and the exact system version under evaluation. Present strict success, partial progress, latency, and throughput in separate columns with clear denominators. Keep representative failures alongside successes and connect every claimed mechanism to an appropriate ablation. Our cup example then becomes a small reproducible study rather than another isolated demonstration. This is how model knowledge becomes the infrastructure needed to build and improve real robotic systems.

description.zh: 机器人专用 Transformer 策略，把图像历史和语言指令连接到离散动作，是早期可扩展语言条件机器人策略。
description.en: Robot-oriented Transformer policy connecting image history and language instructions to discretized actions; an early scalable language-conditioned robot policy.

text.zh: 图像历史，以及通过句子嵌入表示的自然语言任务。原始接口应与后续 RT-X 版本区分。
text.en: Image history plus a natural-language task represented through a sentence embedding. Its original interface must be distinguished from later RT-X variants.

text.zh: 机械臂、夹爪、移动底盘及控制模式的离散动作维度，随后解码到原机器人的指令接口。
text.en: Discretized action dimensions for arm, gripper, base and control mode, decoded to the original robot's command interface.

text.zh: 通过 FiLM 接收指令条件的 EfficientNet、TokenLearner 视觉压缩，以及处理观测历史的 decoder-only Transformer。
text.en: Instruction-conditioned EfficientNet via FiLM, TokenLearner visual compression, and a decoder-only Transformer over the observation history.

text.zh: 根据示范预测分类动作，优化 token 概率，而不是学习世界状态转移目标。
text.en: Categorical action prediction under demonstrations; optimize token likelihood rather than a learned world-transition objective.

text.zh: 动作范围、控制器语义及相机历史必须与训练系统一致，或者通过明确验证的适配器转换。
text.en: Action ranges, controller semantics and available camera history must match the trained system or an explicitly validated adapter.

text.zh: 在所采集机器人语料上进行行为克隆，使用预训练图像/语言组件；与 RT-2 大型 VLM 共同微调不同。
text.en: Behavior-cloning training on the collected robot corpus, with pretrained image/language components; this differs from RT-2's large-VLM co-fine-tuning.

text.zh: 覆盖多任务的原始真实机器人示范；RT-1 数据并不等同于完整 Open X-Embodiment 混合。
text.en: Original real-robot demonstrations across many tasks; the RT-1 corpus is not identical to the full Open X-Embodiment mixture.

text.zh: 示范中的逐步机器人动作标签、任务语言与对齐图像；语言是条件，不是推理能力的独立证明。
text.en: Demonstrated per-step robot action labels, task language and aligned images; language is a condition, not a separate proof of reasoning.

text.zh: 原论文在自己的机器人配置上评估已见任务、未见任务、干扰物/背景，以及长时域组合；应保留各切分与尝试分母。
text.en: Original paper evaluates seen tasks, unseen tasks, distractors/backgrounds and long-horizon compositions on its robot setup. Preserve each split and attempt denominator.

text.zh: 在论文机器人分布内扩展规模，并不保证适用新形态或任意物理技能；高效视觉编码不能解决接口不匹配。
text.en: Scale within the published robot distribution does not guarantee new embodiments or arbitrary physical skills. Efficient image tokenization does not solve interface mismatch.

description.zh: 把预训练 VLM 适配为输出机器人动作 token 字符串，同时保留网络视觉语言训练任务。
description.en: Adapts pretrained VLMs to produce robot actions as token strings while retaining web vision-language training tasks.

text.zh: 机器人图像与任务指令，以及所选 RT-2 版本对应的提示模板和动作词汇。
text.en: Robot image and task instruction, with the exact prompt template and action vocabulary of the chosen RT-2 variant.

text.zh: token 化的底层动作维度，闭环部署时再解码为机器人动作。
text.en: Tokenized low-level action dimensions, decoded into robot actions during closed-loop deployment.

text.zh: 大型预训练视觉语言主干，动作维度使用模型的输出 token 格式表示。
text.en: Large pretrained vision-language backbone, with action dimensions expressed in the model's output-token format.

text.zh: 在机器人轨迹与互联网规模视觉语言任务上，共同微调语言 token 预测目标。
text.en: Co-fine-tune language-token prediction on robotic trajectories and Internet-scale vision-language tasks.

text.zh: token 解码必须采用正确的数值动作约定；部署依赖原始支持机器人与已学习运动能力。
text.en: Token decoding must use the correct numerical action convention; deployment depends on the original supported robot and learned motor repertoire.

text.zh: 论文研究基于 PaLI-X 与 PaLM-E 的版本，并在机器人共同微调中保留网络任务；不要把不同版本混成同一权重。
text.en: The paper studies PaLI-X and PaLM-E based variants and keeps web tasks during robot co-fine-tuning; do not collapse variants into one checkpoint.

text.zh: 机器人轨迹与网络视觉语言任务混合；具体比例和模型规模属于特定论文版本。
text.en: Robot trajectory data mixed with web vision-language tasks; exact mixtures and model sizes belong to specific paper variants.

text.zh: 动作 token 目标与普通视觉语言 token 目标；示范把语言连接到可执行机器人接口。
text.en: Action token targets plus ordinary vision-language token targets; demonstrations ground language in an executable robot interface.

text.zh: 区分已见任务、视觉泛化、语义泛化与选定推理测试；抓取机器人与 Language Table 是不同配置。
text.en: Separate seen-task performance, visual generalization, semantic generalization, and selected reasoning tests. Grasping robots and Language Table are distinct setups.

text.zh: 语义迁移不证明仅靠文本就获得任意新运动技能；精选示例不是总体成功率。
text.en: Semantic transfer does not demonstrate acquisition of arbitrary new motor skills from text alone. Selected examples are not aggregate success statistics.

description.zh: 使用 Open X-Embodiment 数据集合进行跨形态训练的研究及相关策略。
description.en: Cross-embodiment training study and related policies using the Open X-Embodiment dataset collection.

text.zh: 根据各策略支持的机器人数据接口标准化后的图像和语言指令。
text.en: Images and language instructions standardized for each policy's supported robot-data interface.

text.zh: 在选定 RT-X 模型与机器人适配器下定义的离散末端动作。
text.en: Discretized end-effector actions under the selected RT-X model and robot adapter.

text.zh: RT-1-X 采用机器人专用路线；RT-2-X 扩展基于 VLM 的动作 token 建模；它们是同一数据计划下不同路线。
text.en: RT-1-X is robot-oriented; RT-2-X extends VLM-based action-token modeling. They are separate model routes under one data initiative.

text.zh: 根据多个机器人形态的示范，学习可迁移的动作预测。
text.en: Learn transferable action prediction from demonstrations across multiple robot embodiments.

text.zh: 共享存储格式不等于共享身体；机器人坐标、夹爪、控制和观测选择仍然重要。
text.en: A shared storage format is not a shared physical body; robot-specific coordinates, grippers, control and observation choices remain relevant.

text.zh: 在记录明确的多机器人混合上训练 RT 架构；区分架构变化与数据混合变化。
text.en: Train related RT architectures on documented multi-robot mixtures; distinguish architecture changes from data-mixture changes.

text.zh: Open X-Embodiment 包含异构数据集、机器人、任务和场景；保留论文版本对应清单及筛选训练子集。
text.en: Open X-Embodiment: heterogeneous datasets, robots, tasks and scenes. Preserve the paper-version-specific inventory and curated training subsets.

text.zh: 机器人观测、指令和示范命令，经变换后符合支持的动作约定。
text.en: Robot observations, instructions and demonstrated commands, transformed to supported action conventions.

text.zh: 采用论文内同机器人和跨机器人迁移比较，并保留原始基线、任务选择及评估次数。
text.en: Use the paper's within-robot and cross-robot transfer comparisons, retaining the original baseline, task selection and evaluation counts.

text.zh: 整个集合的规模不一定等于某模型实际训练子集；已测机器人上的迁移，不代表任意身体上的零样本迁移。
text.en: The collection's total size is not necessarily the exact training subset for a particular model. Transfer on tested robots is not zero-shot transfer to any body.

title.zh: OpenVLA

description.zh: 开放的 VLM 衍生机器人策略，提供训练和适配流程；原始版本使用离散动作预测。
description.en: Open VLM-derived robot policy with an accessible training and adaptation pipeline; the original release uses discretized action prediction.

text.zh: 原始模型输入图像和自然语言指令；不要自动把后续衍生版本的多图像或本体状态输入算进来。
text.en: An image and natural-language instruction in the original model; do not automatically assume multiple images or proprioception from later derivatives.

text.zh: 通过正确数据集归一化键，解码离散预测 token，得到七维机器人动作。
text.en: Seven-dimensional robot actions obtained by decoding predicted discrete tokens with the correct dataset normalization key.

text.zh: DINOv2 与 SigLIP 特征、投影层，以及通过 Prismatic 初始化的 Llama 2 语言主干。
text.en: DINOv2 and SigLIP features, a projection layer, and a Llama 2 language backbone initialized through Prismatic.

text.zh: 在机器人数据上进行下一动作 token 预测；微调可更新全部参数，或采用参数高效适配。
text.en: Next-token action prediction on robot data; fine-tuning can update all parameters or use parameter-efficient adaptations.

text.zh: 必须匹配归一化统计、夹爪约定、图像预处理与所支持动作接口。
text.en: Correct normalization statistics, gripper convention, image preprocessing and supported action interface are required.

text.zh: 在筛选 OpenX 机器人混合上适配 Prismatic VLM，再可选微调到新配置；该阶段并不保留 RT-2 式网络共同训练。
text.en: Adapt Prismatic VLM on the curated OpenX robot mixture, then optionally fine-tune for new robot settings; this stage does not preserve RT-2-style web co-training.

text.zh: 论文报告筛选后的 97 万回合机器人混合，不是未经筛选的全部 OpenX 数据集或帧。
text.en: The paper reports a curated 970k-episode robot mixture, not every dataset or frame in OpenX without filtering.

text.zh: 对齐图像、语言指令和离散示范动作；适配标签必须保留物理接口含义。
text.en: Aligned images, language instructions and discretized demonstration actions; adaptation labels must preserve the physical interface.

text.zh: 原评估区分 WidowX/Google 开箱运行与 Franka 适配；单指令任务和语言丰富任务的基线表现不同。
text.en: Original evaluations separate WidowX/Google out-of-box performance from Franka adaptation; single-instruction and language-rich tasks differ in baseline behavior.

text.zh: 原始动作 token 解码不是 OFT 方案；语义鲁棒性受训练限制，也不同于精密单任务控制。
text.en: Original action-token decoding is not the OFT recipe. Semantic robustness is bounded by training and differs from precise single-task control.

title.zh: OpenVLA-OFT

description.zh: 针对 OpenVLA 的优化微调方案，改变解码、动作表示与训练目标。
description.en: An optimized fine-tuning recipe for OpenVLA that changes decoding, action representation and training objective.

text.zh: 图像、语言，以及由实现配置决定的机器人状态；多图像和本体输入属于评估扩展的一部分。
text.en: Images, language and implementation-configured robot state; multi-image and proprioceptive inputs are part of the evaluated extensions.

text.zh: 并行解码的连续动作块，接口维度适配目标任务或机器人。
text.en: Continuous action chunks decoded in parallel, with interface dimensions adapted to the target task or robot.

text.zh: VLM 主干搭配并行动作解码与连续动作头，并扩展输入接口；OFT+ 包含 FiLM。
text.en: VLM backbone with parallel action decoding and a continuous action head, plus input/interface extensions; OFT+ includes FiLM.

text.zh: 比较不同动作目标后，核心方案选择 L1 回归，而不是自回归动作 token 损失。
text.en: L1 regression is the chosen core recipe after comparing action objectives; it is not an autoregressive action-token loss.

text.zh: 保留目标动作约定、微调数据与执行时域；ALOHA 的 OFT+ 版本还通过 FiLM 强化语言落地。
text.en: Preserve target action conventions, fine-tuning data and executed horizon. The ALOHA OFT+ variant additionally strengthens language grounding through FiLM.

text.zh: 从预训练 OpenVLA 初始化出发，采用论文中的并行解码、分块和连续动作选择进行微调。
text.en: Fine-tune a pretrained OpenVLA initialization, using the paper's parallel decoding, chunking and continuous action choices.

text.zh: OpenVLA 预训练，加上目标 LIBERO 或 ALOHA 示范；不能说成仅使用最后的目标数据训练。
text.en: OpenVLA pretraining plus target LIBERO or ALOHA demonstrations; do not describe it as training only from the final target set.

text.zh: 在连续回归目标下监督示范动作块，并采用任务语言条件。
text.en: Target demonstration action chunks under continuous regression, with task language conditioning.

text.zh: 区分四组 LIBERO 仿真结果与真实双臂 ALOHA 实验；保留各基线适配方案和计算条件。
text.en: Separate four-suite LIBERO simulation results from real bimanual ALOHA experiments; preserve each baseline's adaptation recipe and compute context.

text.zh: 已发表提升依赖被测微调协议；生成吞吐不等于端到端反应时间，也不等于任务吞吐。
text.en: Published improvements are conditional on the measured fine-tuning protocols. Generation throughput is not the same as end-to-end response time or task throughput.

title.zh: Octo

description.zh: 为灵活任务定义、观测与动作空间设计的可复用通用机器人策略。
description.en: Reusable generalist robot policy designed for flexible task definitions, observations and action spaces.

text.zh: 语言或目标图像任务说明、观测历史，以及受支持相机和状态模态。
text.en: Language or goal-image task specification, observation histories, and supported camera/state modalities.

text.zh: 扩散头产生的连续动作块，适配时可以引入新的动作头。
text.en: Continuous action chunks from a diffusion head, with new action heads possible during adaptation.

text.zh: 观测/任务编码器、包含读出 token 的 Transformer，以及扩散动作头。
text.en: Observation/task tokenizers, a Transformer with readout tokens, and diffusion action heads.

text.zh: 对机器人示范动作块进行条件扩散建模。
text.en: Conditional diffusion action modeling over robot demonstration chunks.

text.zh: 新传感器和动作接口需要明确配置编码器与动作头；灵活并不意味着任意新输入未经训练即可使用。
text.en: New sensors and action interfaces require explicitly configured tokenizers and heads; flexibility does not mean untrained arbitrary inputs work immediately.

text.zh: 先在筛选 OpenX 混合上预训练 Transformer 策略，再针对新机器人配置适配模块与主干。
text.en: Pretrain the Transformer policy on a curated OpenX mixture, then adapt relevant modules and backbone for new robot settings.

text.zh: 发表模型使用筛选后的 80 万轨迹 OpenX 子集；模型训练混合比整个数据集合更具体。
text.en: The published model uses a curated 800k-trajectory OpenX subset; model training mixtures are more specific than the whole collection.

text.zh: 语言或目标图像条件与示范动作块配对；传感器/动作掩码支持异构数据集。
text.en: Language or goal-image conditioning paired with demonstrated action chunks; sensor/action masks support heterogeneous datasets.

text.zh: 区分在预训练支持配置中的开箱测试，以及新观测/动作空间微调；采用 v2 论文的九平台范围。
text.en: Distinguish out-of-box tests in pretraining-supported settings from fine-tuning to new observation/action spaces; use the v2 paper's nine-platform scope.

text.zh: 通用初始化不意味着获得大型 VLM 式强语义迁移；微调与任务接口匹配仍然重要。
text.en: A generalist initialization does not imply strong semantic transfer from a large VLM. Fine-tuning and task/interface match remain important.

description.zh: 带流匹配动作专家的紧凑 VLA，并配套异步执行系统。
description.en: Compact VLA with a flow-matching action expert and an accompanying asynchronous execution system.

text.zh: 配置接口下的多路 RGB 视图、语言指令和投影后的感觉运动状态。
text.en: Multiple RGB views, language instruction and projected sensorimotor state under the configured interface.

text.zh: 连续动作块；异步机器人客户端可把新预测与剩余排队动作合并。
text.en: Continuous action chunks; an asynchronous robot client may merge updated predictions with remaining queued actions.

text.zh: 源自 SmolVLM2 的视觉语言特征、减少视觉 token 与深度，以及采用交替注意力的流匹配动作专家。
text.en: SmolVLM2-derived visual/language features, reduced visual tokens and depth, interleaved attention in a flow-matching action expert.

text.zh: 在紧凑 VLM 特征条件下训练流匹配动作专家。
text.en: Flow-matching action-expert training conditioned on compact VLM features.

text.zh: 相机命名、归一化、目标机器人形态及动作队列配置，必须与数据和部署代码匹配。
text.en: Camera naming, normalization, target embodiment and action queue configuration must match the dataset and deployment code.

text.zh: 使用紧凑预训练 SmolVLM2 主干，保留中间层；论文冻结 VLM，并训练动作专家。
text.en: Uses a compact pretrained SmolVLM2 backbone, retaining intermediate layers; the paper freezes the VLM and trains the action expert.

text.zh: 预训练使用筛选后的开放 LeRobot 社区机器人数据，随后使用任务或基准专用适配数据。
text.en: Curated open LeRobot community robot datasets for pretraining, followed by task/benchmark-specific adaptation data.

text.zh: 机器人记录动作与图像、状态及改进任务标注配对；冻结语义特征不意味着标注质量不再重要。
text.en: Recorded robot actions paired with images, state and improved task annotations; frozen semantic features do not eliminate annotation quality concerns.

text.zh: 区分 LIBERO/Meta-World 适配、SO100/SO101 真实机器人评估，以及同步/异步比较。
text.en: Keep LIBERO/Meta-World adaptation separate from SO100/SO101 real robot evaluations and synchronous/asynchronous comparisons.

text.zh: 4.5 亿参数和消费级使用门槛，不保证每台主机的延迟；可训练硬件与可靠闭环任务表现是不同问题。
text.en: 450M parameters and consumer accessibility do not guarantee latency on every host. Training hardware feasibility is distinct from reliable closed-loop task behavior.

description.zh: 基于 VLM 的通用机器人策略，带通过流匹配训练的连续动作专家。

text.zh: 机器人相机观测、任务语言和机器人状态，按目标形态配置。
text.en: Robot camera observations, task language and robot state, configured for the target embodiment.

text.zh: 连续机器人动作块，映射到对应形态的控制接口。
text.en: Continuous chunks of robot actions, mapped to the embodiment's control interface.

text.zh: 预训练 VLM 主干加独立动作专家，使用连续状态/动作嵌入与迭代流积分。

text.zh: 学习观测条件速度场，把噪声输运到示范动作块。

text.zh: 需要兼容状态/动作适配器与正确归一化；积分时间是生成过程时间，而不是物理执行时间。
text.en: Compatible robot-state/action adapters and correct normalization are necessary; integration time is generative time rather than physical execution time.

text.zh: 结合预训练视觉语言知识与多样机器人动作预训练，再对选定困难任务进行后训练。
text.en: Combine pretrained vision-language knowledge with diverse robot action pretraining, then post-train for selected difficult tasks.

text.zh: 选定开放机器人数据，加 Physical Intelligence 采集的灵巧机器人经验；任务专门化使用额外相关数据。
text.en: Selected open robot data plus Physical Intelligence's collected dexterous robot experience; task specialization uses additional relevant data.

text.zh: 示范动作块提供流匹配目标；任务语言与观测作为策略条件。
text.en: Demonstration action chunks provide flow targets; task language and observations condition the policy.

text.zh: 区分基础提示运行、专门后训练，以及语言跟随测试；若干长任务结果采用部分任务进展分数。
text.en: Separate base prompting, specialist post-training and language-following tests. Several long-horizon results use partial task-progress scores.

text.zh: 进展分数不是二元成功率；作者 PDF 与博客的数据清单总结可能不同，本课程不混合不兼容计数。
text.en: A progress score is not binary task success. The author PDF and blog may summarize dataset inventory differently; this course avoids merging incompatible counts.

description.zh: 动作序列分词器，本身不是完整 VLA；把时间结构压缩为适合自回归学习的 token。
description.en: Action sequence tokenizer, not a complete VLA by itself. Compresses temporal structure into tokens suitable for autoregressive learning.

text.zh: 具有明确通道顺序与时间采样约定的归一化连续动作块。
text.en: Normalized continuous action chunks with an explicit channel ordering and temporal sampling convention.

text.zh: 压缩离散 token，以及能够重建连续动作块的逆解码过程。
text.en: Compressed discrete tokens and an inverse decoding procedure that reconstructs continuous action chunks.

text.zh: 时间离散余弦变换、系数量化/序列化与 BPE；逆变换及反归一化后恢复物理动作值。
text.en: Temporal discrete cosine transform, coefficient quantization/serialization and BPE; inverse transformations recover physical-action values after denormalization.

text.zh: 变换并量化动作时间序列，再用字节对编码压缩序列化系数；下游策略预测这些 token。
text.en: Transform and quantize action time series, then compress serialized coefficients with byte-pair encoding; the downstream policy predicts these tokens.

text.zh: 分词器归一化、量化和解码必须匹配策略训练；重建质量与策略可预测性是不同指标。
text.en: The tokenizer's normalization, quantization and decoding must match policy training; reconstruction quality is separate from policy predictability.

text.zh: FAST 建立压缩分词流程，FAST+ 是广泛训练的分词器；独立 VLA 仍需在观测动作配对上训练。
text.en: FAST fits the compression/tokenization pipeline; FAST+ is a broadly trained tokenizer. A separate VLA is still trained on observation-action pairs.

text.zh: 涵盖多样机器人的动作序列；FAST+ 分词器训练与下游 VLA 训练，是不同的数据用途。
text.en: Action sequences spanning diverse robot data; FAST+ tokenizer training and downstream VLA training are distinct data uses.

text.zh: 分词器构建使用动作信号；下游自回归策略根据观测，以示范 token 序列为监督。
text.en: Tokenizer construction uses action signals; the downstream autoregressive policy uses demonstrated token sequences conditioned on observations.

text.zh: 区分编码重建/压缩测试、策略训练效率，以及论文任务中的机器人运行。
text.en: Separate token reconstruction/compression tests, policy training efficiency and downstream robot rollouts across the paper's tasks.

text.zh: 较短 token 序列不保证低任务延迟或高成功率；量化、裁剪及下游 token 预测误差仍然重要。
text.en: Short token sequences do not guarantee low task latency or high success. Quantization, clipping and downstream token errors remain relevant.

text.zh: 通过迭代去噪采样连续动作序列，并在滚动时域控制下使用。
text.en: Continuous action sequences sampled by iterative denoising and used under receding-horizon control.

text.zh: 条件时间 CNN 或 Transformer 去噪网络、观测编码器，以及迭代动作采样器。
text.en: Conditional temporal CNN or Transformer denoising network, observation encoder and iterative action sampler.

text.zh: 在观测条件下，学习含噪示范动作的去噪信息。
text.en: Learn denoising information for noised demonstration actions conditioned on observations.

text.zh: 噪声计划、采样器、观测时域、预测时域与执行时域，都属于策略定义的一部分。
text.en: Noise schedule, sampler, observation horizon, prediction horizon and execution horizon belong to the policy specification.

text.zh: 使用示范动作序列进行任务专用模仿；扩散步是优化/推理计算，不是机器人控制时间步。
text.en: Task-specific imitation using demonstrated action sequences; diffusion steps are optimization/inference computation, not robot control timesteps.

text.zh: 被评估操作任务的示范数据集；与通用 VLA 比较时必须说明预训练数据权限。
text.en: Demonstration datasets for the evaluated manipulation tasks; pretraining access must be stated when comparing with generalist VLAs.

text.zh: 向示范动作序列施加已知噪声，并以对应观测作为条件。
text.en: Known noise applied to demonstration action sequences, with corresponding observations for conditioning.

text.zh: 区分状态/图像基准与物理任务；明确比较动作时域、控制表示及数据权限。
text.en: Separate state-based/image-based benchmarks and physical tasks; compare action horizons, control representation and data access explicitly.

text.zh: 多峰生成不是碰撞避免或任务成功保证；带语言条件的衍生版本必须说明新增语言编码器及训练。
text.en: Multimodal generation is not a collision or task-success guarantee. A language-conditioned derivative must state its added language encoder and training.

title.zh: 知识隔离

description.zh: 训练方案：隔离动作专家梯度与 VLM 表示学习，同时保留连续动作推理。
description.en: Training recipe that separates action-expert gradients from VLM representation learning while retaining continuous inference.

text.zh: 图像、任务/子任务语言和机器人状态，并配合离散动作与通用 VLM 训练样本。
text.en: Images, task/subtask language and robot state, alongside discrete-action and general VLM training examples.

text.zh: 训练时输出 token 预测与连续动作估计；部署时可直接使用动作专家，不必生成离散动作。
text.en: During training, token predictions and continuous action estimates; deployment can use the action expert without discrete action generation.

text.zh: VLM 主干加连续动作专家，并在专家损失与主干之间设置明确梯度截断边界。
text.en: VLM backbone plus continuous action expert with an explicit stop-gradient boundary between the expert loss and backbone.

text.zh: 通过 token 目标训练主干，通过流匹配训练动作专家，并在梯度进入主干前截断。
text.en: Train the backbone through token objectives and the action expert through flow matching, stopping expert gradients before the backbone.

text.zh: 梯度截断是选择性的，并不意味着整个主干被冻结；共享特征仍然为动作专家提供条件。
text.en: Stop-gradient is selective; it does not imply the whole backbone is frozen. Shared features still condition the action expert.

text.zh: 在分离梯度路径下联合学习，使用 FAST 动作 token 监督，以及配置中的通用视觉语言监督。
text.en: Joint learning with separated gradient paths, FAST-tokenized action supervision and general vision-language supervision where configured.

text.zh: 机器人动作数据与配置中的通用 VLM 数据；监督来源和梯度路径是不同设计维度。
text.en: Robot action data and configured general VLM datasets; data supervision and gradient routing are separate design dimensions.

text.zh: 用于表示学习的离散 token 损失、动作专家的连续流损失，以及通用 VLM token 目标。
text.en: Discrete token loss for representation learning, continuous flow loss for the expert, and general VLM token objectives.

text.zh: 依据论文的匹配与消融方案，比较训练收敛、语言跟随、动作质量及执行时间。
text.en: Compare training convergence, language following, action quality and execution time using the paper's matching and ablation choices.

text.zh: 它是一套方案，不是独立且不受形态限制的机器人；已发表比较不证明存在普遍最优的梯度规则。
text.en: It is a recipe, not a standalone embodiment-independent robot. Published comparisons do not establish a universal optimal gradient rule.
